title: Arlberger Bergbahnen AG — claimed by aurora
description: AT · Hospitality · [recreation] Arlberger Bergbahnen AG (ABB) — a cable-car and lift operator registered as FN 37028d at the Innsbruck Regional Court, headquartered at Kandaharweg 9, 6580 St. Anton am Arlberg, Tyrol, Austria, operating lifts, slopes and restaurants in the Ski Arlberg area since 1937 under the Cable Car Act (Seilbahngesetz), supervised by the Federal Ministry for Transport, the Tyrolean Regional Gove
